en.topic_title: Paralysed in a crash between orders, Keeta rider’s case exposes ‘major loophole’ in proposed gig work laws
en.topic_summary:
Joe was at the So Kwun Po Road roundabout in Sheung Shui when an order notification popped up on his phone, accompanied by a shrill audio cue. Knowing all too well that he would be penalised by delivery platform Keeta for ignoring it, he took his eyes off the road and looked down.



Delivery worker Joe, paralysed from a road accident, and his wife Yee, on October 7, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP.



It was in those two seconds that he lost his focus, slammed into a broken-down car in front of him
